# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Excellent detached two storey property built in 2005 and standing on a large corner site. The property has oil fired heating, double glazed windows and Palladio front door and is in pristine condition throughout. There is a large cobble lock driveway to the front and side access to rear enclosed garden with large, detached shed.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Energetická náročnost: B3
- Lokalita: 6 Galteeview, Cahir
- Cena: 380 000 €
